root_causes.description: The checkout container was killed ('Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted') and replacement pods could never become Ready because the sandbox pause image gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest failed to pull (DeadlineExceeded -> ErrImagePull -> ImagePullBackOff). With pods unavailable, the checkout Deployment's available replicas fell below desired, firing KubeDeploymentReplicasMismatch; checkout served near-zero traffic (request_rate ~0.01 req/s, CPU ~0.002 cores) during the window.

evidence.query_or_id: Killing: Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted (count=2)
evidence.observed_value: checkout container killed/restarted 2 times during the incident window
evidence.expected_baseline: no Killing/restart events for checkout pods in steady state

evidence.observed_value: 3 ImagePullBackOff events; also 'Back-off pulling image "gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest" (count=3)' and 'Failed to pull image "gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest": rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded (count=3)'
evidence.expected_baseline: replacement pods start successfully; no ErrImagePull/ImagePullBackOff events

evidence.observed_value: request_rate mean=0.010 req/s, p50=0.000 (checkout effectively not serving traffic)
evidence.expected_baseline: checkout request_rate > 1 req/s under normal load-generator traffic

evidence.observed_value: cpu_usage mean=0.002 cores, max=0.009 cores (near-zero, pods down/not ready)
evidence.expected_baseline: checkout CPU usage well above 0.01 cores under normal traffic

root_causes.description: With checkout pods unavailable, frontend requests depending on checkout timed out: frontend p99 latency pinned at 10000ms (timeout signature) and frontend error_rate rose to ~0.05-0.12, propagating the checkout outage to end users.

evidence.observed_value: p99_latency_ms = 10000.000 flat across the window (mean/p50/p95/p99/max all 10000)
evidence.expected_baseline: frontend p99 latency in the low hundreds of ms

root_causes.description: Traces touching checkout during the window show extreme durations (p95=54483ms, top traces at 15000ms) with zero span-level errors, consistent with callers blocking on timeouts while checkout pods were unavailable rather than slow in-process work (CPU and memory near zero).

evidence.observed_value: search_traces(checkout, error_only=true): 20 traces, 0 errors, p95_duration=54483ms; top traces 8d7291c48ceeb50a / cfc31e658325f268 / eee274c3dd553f3e each ~15000ms
memory mean=19815787 bytes, max=41394176 bytes (~41MB, no memory pressure)
evidence.expected_baseline: no OOM-level memory growth; rules out memory_stress as cause

remediation_steps: Fix the image pull failure for gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest (pre-pull/cache the pause image on nodes, or point the pod sandbox image at an accessible registry/mirror) so replacement checkout pods can start.
Review and roll back or correct the checkout deployment definition change that triggered the container kills ('Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted').
Verify the checkout Deployment returns to its desired replica count and is Ready (kubectl -n otel-demo rollout status deployment/checkout), then confirm request_rate and CPU recover.
Monitor frontend p99 latency and error_rate until they return to baseline once checkout is serving traffic again.
Add alerting on ErrImagePull/ImagePullBackOff and KubeDeploymentReplicasMismatch with faster notification to catch pod-startup failures before user impact.
